title: Open Mic @ Thank You Miami
event_description: Weekly open mic welcoming all talents including musicians and comedians. Community-focused event with supportive atmosphere. Musicians allowed 2 songs per set and comedians get 5-minute sets.
venue_address: 1701 West Flagler St Suite 101 Miami FL 33135
event_venue_information:
About Thank You Miami Cocina & Beerhouse

Thank You Miami is an irreverent and friendly cocina and beer house that has become a cornerstone of Miami's open mic scene since opening in 2021. The venue features a spacious interior with art and games throughout creating a welcoming atmosphere for performers and audiences alike.

Music and Events

Beyond the Wednesday open mic the venue hosts Comedy Night and Karaoke events. The open mic night is known for its soul and deep profound atmosphere that balances loose fun with heartfelt performance. Host Trikstah sets an amazing tone with spoken word poetry modern R&B singing and pep talks on the transformative power of performing arts.

Food and Drink

The venue offers a Miami-themed menu and features a serve-yourself drinks cooler. The casual atmosphere combines great food with a commitment to supporting local artists and creating community.

title: Jazz Jam @ Churchill's Pub
event_description: Monday night jazz jam featuring the Fernando Ulibarri Quartet on the main stage. Includes the Raven Open Mic in the beer garden for poets musicians and artists. Two distinct vibes in one iconic venue.
event_venue_information:
About Churchill's Pub

Churchill's Pub is a legendary Miami venue that first opened in 1979 and has been called the CBGB of the South. After a five-year closure the venue triumphantly reopened in September 2025 reclaiming its spot as Miami's home for underground music art and culture.

Music Legacy

Churchill's holds the world record for most acts within a single venue having hosted over 20000 performances. Famous musicians including Marilyn Manson Social Distortion The Mavericks Dick Dale Agent Orange and Iggy Pop have all played the pub. The venue has shaped generations of artists and fostered Miami's untamed creative energy.

Atmosphere and Events

Known as the cradle of everything indie and the institution for live music in Miami Churchill's hosts events every night of the week. The venue features both an indoor stage and outdoor beer garden courtyard. Monday nights feature Jazz in the Church with the Fernando Ulibarri Quartet leading world-class improvisation while the Raven Open Mic unfolds in the Bohemian beer garden with spoken word poets musicians and visual artists.

title: Blues Jam @ The Fish House
event_description: Weekly blues jam session hosted by house band featuring talented local musicians. New Orleans-inspired atmosphere with professional sound setup. Open to all instrumentalists and vocalists.
hosts: Rachelle Coba - Guitar/Vocals Darrell Raines - Guitar Conrad Itchener - Bass Ray Robinson - Drums
event_venue_information:
About The Fish House

The Fish House Miami was established in 1996 and has grown into one of Miami's premier seafood restaurants with an exceptional live music program. The venue combines fresh seafood with blues and jazz creating a unique New Orleans meets Miami experience.

Music Program

The Fish House hosts different music events throughout the week including Wednesday Jazz Jam and Thursday Best Blues Jam. The venue features BackRoom Live voted Best Open Mic Night and has become a sought-after stage for young local artists to get their voices heard. The atmosphere mirrors New Orleans jazz joints with dimly lit ambiance and rich instrumental music.

Food and Atmosphere

Celebrating 30 years of business The Fish House offers fresh catch-of-the-day seafood with nautical relaxed decor featuring marine elements and trophy fish. The venue has been praised by Miami Herald as worth a drive and noted for fabulous fish and fresh tasty fare. The restaurant also features a raw bar sushi menu and happy hour specials.

title: Open Mic @ Tea & Poets
event_description: All-ages weekly open mic in spacious tea and coffee shop. Supportive audience welcoming to singers musicians comedians and neophyte performers. Community-focused event bringing together diverse talented performers.
venue_address: 5701 Sunset Dr Unit 126 South Miami FL 33143
event_venue_information:
About Tea & Poets

Tea & Poets is a spacious tea and coffee shop and community space located in Sunset Place that has created a haven of good vibes and high energy. The venue features an indoor art walk style market full service tea bar and stage for live performances.

Open Mic and Events

The Wednesday open mic is known for having one of the most supportive and inclusive audiences in Miami. The event is open to people of all ages and talents fostering a community where vulnerable neophyte performers find a tribe to call their own alongside wildly talented singers musicians and comedians. Something bigger than just an open mic happens here with love and acceptance flowing freely.

Venue Features

The venue offers an extensive selection of reasonably priced organic teas with Tuesday specials at three dollars for small specialty teas. The space includes several vendors selling plants soaps Mexican silver art jewelry and clothing. Free WiFi charging stations comfortable chairs sofas and tables along with board games make it an ideal hangout spot.

title: Musicians Night @ Savage Labs
event_description: Curated open mic featuring professional musicians and newcomers. High-quality production with large crowds of music lovers. Sign-up available online until day before show. One of Miami's best open mics.
event_venue_information:
About Savage Labs Wynwood

Savage Labs is a unique restaurant cocktail bar and lounge in the vibrant Wynwood Arts District. The venue was awarded Best Intimate Music Venue in Miami New Times Best of Miami awards in 2023 and is known for blending a relaxed homey atmosphere with commitment to showcasing local art and talent.

Music and Entertainment

Savage Labs positions itself as a community-driven establishment deeply rooted in Miami hospitality with a mission to showcase local talent. The venue regularly hosts eclectic live entertainment including live bands open mic nights DJ sets circus shows and art showcases. Musicians Night on Tuesdays features both professional musicians and those new to performing regularly drawing large crowds.

Atmosphere

The venue creates a warm welcoming space reminiscent of a cozy living room contrasting with typical club environments. The intimate music venue and social lounge hosts record label showcases and events dedicated to local artists making it a hub for Miami's creative community.

title: Live Band Karaoke @ Magic 13 Brewing
event_description: Wednesday night live band karaoke and open mic. Sing with a live band in pet and family-friendly brewery setting. Reggae nights Samba parties and diverse live music events throughout the week.
event_venue_information:
About Magic 13 Brewing Co

Magic 13 Brewing Co was named Best Live Music Venue by Miami Herald. Located in Little Haiti this craft brewery and distillery features a spacious indoor taproom and expansive beer garden with capacity for 350 patrons. The venue is both kid and pet-friendly making it an inclusive destination.

Music and Events

Magic 13 hosts a packed weekly calendar with Magic Mondays all-night happy hour Comedy Tuesdays with stand-up shows Karaoke Wednesdays sometimes with live band Reggae and Ladies Night Thursdays live music on Fridays and Saturdays and BBQ Sundays with live music from 11am. The venue features both indoor and outdoor stages with great acoustics.

Food and Drink

The brewery crafts exceptional house-made beers including Islander smooth crisp lager and other local favorites. Magic Kitchen provides delicious food including St Louis-style ribs and other fresh dishes. The venue has partnered with Meat and Bone for a mouthwatering food menu perfect for pairing with craft beers.

title: Open Mic @ Vice City Kava
event_description: Monday night open mic in cozy kava bar with unique art and comfortable seating. Welcoming atmosphere for musicians poets and performers. Games board games and PS5 available.
event_venue_information:
About Vice City Kava

Vice City Kava is a unique kava bar and lounge in Coral Gables inspired by 1980s Miami. The venue promotes natural relaxation through kava and tea as healthy alternatives creating a safe welcoming space for the alternative living community. The cozy atmosphere features unique artwork comfortable seating and a home away from home vibe.

Events and Entertainment

Weekly events include Open Mic on Mondays and Jazz Jam on Wednesdays. The venue has been described as a kava tea room/underground Miami jazz scene/new age speakeasy/artist studio all in one. Host Sofi Sicuso is known as one of the warmest most engaged and encouraging hosts regularly incorporating evocative reimaginings of classic jams.

Venue Features

Vice City Kava offers an extensive expertly crafted menu of kava and tea beverages with favorites like Kava Cocaine Sunrise and Sploosh. The space includes hookah games like chess video games PS5 Nintendo Switch board games and a sweet thrift shop in the back. Clean bathrooms and welcoming staff create an excellent atmosphere for relaxation socialization or productivity.
